newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN BOSS MILLER RESIGNS FOLLOWING DERBY DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN BOSS MILLER RESIGNS FOLLOWING DERBY DEFEAT.

text.p: Hibernian manager Alex Miller resigned on Monday in the wake of Saturday's Edinburgh derby defeat by arch-rivals Heart of Midlothian.
Miller, who has been in charge of the club for almost 10 years, was under increasing pressure after a poor run of results which continued when Hearts won 3-1 at Hibs on Saturday.
He had two years of his contract left to run but he has come to an agreement with the Board of Directors over the outstanding terms.
Miller guided the team to success in the Scottish League Cup in 1991. Hibs are currently sixth in the 10-team Scottish premier division.
